key.name: simulation-enabled
key.summary: Play simulated demo events instead of showing events from the daemon

key.name: audio-events
key.summary: Show audio output, microphone and microphone mute changes

key.name: hide-gnome-banners
key.summary: Hide GNOME's notification banners while the island shows notifications

key.name: monitor-index
key.summary: Monitor to show the island on (-1 = primary)

key.name: below-top-bar
key.summary: Place the island below the top bar instead of over it

key.name: top-margin
key.summary: Gap between the island and the screen edge it is placed at, in pixels

key.name: idle-width
key.summary: Width when there are no events

key.name: idle-width-match-clock
key.summary: Make the idle island as wide as the top bar clock

key.name: idle-height
key.summary: Height when there are no events (grows under the pointer)

key.name: allow-drag
key.summary: Allow moving the island by dragging it

key.name: default-anchor
key.summary: Default position (where Reset and snap-back put the island)

key.name: default-x
key.summary: Custom default: horizontal center as a fraction of the monitor width

key.name: default-y
key.summary: Custom default: top edge as a fraction of the monitor height

key.name: custom-position
key.summary: Use the dragged position instead of the default position

key.name: position-x
key.summary: Dragged position: horizontal center as a fraction of the monitor width

key.name: position-y
key.summary: Dragged position: top edge as a fraction of the monitor height

key.name: compact-width
key.summary: Width of the compact island

key.name: compact-height
key.summary: Height of the idle and compact island

key.name: expanded-width
key.summary: Width of the expanded island

key.name: show-when-idle
key.summary: Show a small pill when there are no events

key.name: auto-expand
key.summary: Briefly expand when a new most-important event arrives

key.name: auto-expand-ms
key.summary: How long an automatic expansion lasts, in milliseconds

key.name: animation-duration-scale
key.summary: Animation duration multiplier (0 = no animation)
